fix(postgres): scope cancellation idempotency

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-43
  description: |-
    Preserve completion-first cancellation audit receipts without treating them as permanent Attempt-level authority. Replay exact command receipts, scope active idempotency to the current Operation and dispatch generation, and keep requested cancellation snapshots authoritative for late callbacks.
    
    Allow append-only cancellation history per Attempt and cover advancement from completed Planning to a cancellable Implementation operation.
